**Finding submitted — T4C: missing (Customer convenience right).**

- **What the document does:** The Base Agreement has a three-year initial term (§4.0, p0104) and Section 5.0 permits termination only for cause — material breach, insolvency events, competitor acquisition, and continuing force majeure (§5.1, p0107–p0118). Sections 5.2/5.3 only handle post-termination inventory and pricing.
- **Other exits checked:** §4.0 six-month non-renewal notice (natural-term non-renewal → RENEWAL rule, not flagged here); SOW §2.0 twelve-month non-renewal (p0658); SOW §6.1 IBM purchase-order cancellation "at any time" (p0722) — PO-level only and subject to cost reimbursement; §16.17 force majeure termination (cause-based); AECI §8 mutual notice termination (p1497) governs only the confidentiality exchange form, not the services term.
- **Direction check:** MSL has no mid-term convenience right — §5.1's "Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary … for cause" opener carries preferred element 4, so I marked it already_met rather than adding a redundant prohibition against MSL.
- **Redline (preferred, validated ok:true):** one insertion of a new §5.4 after p0143 giving IBM convenience termination on 30 days' written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, with the 60–90 day fallback offered in the comment. No "in whole or in part", no penalty or survival boilerplate added.
